{{Quote|My father died in the great Battle of the Plains, avenging the great wrong of the Melida during the Battle of the North&mdash;''"<br />"''Which had taken place a century before!|Hologram of [[Micae]] and [[Nield]]|<ref name="Jedi Apprentice: The Defenders of the Dead">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Defenders of the Dead]]''</ref>}}
The '''Battle of the North''' occurred at some point before [[94 BBY/Legends|94 BBY]]. It was one of the many struggles of the [[Melida/Daan Civil War]]. Over a century later, the [[Daan (people)/Legends|Daan]] took revenge on the [[Melida/Legends|Melida]] for it in the [[Battle of the Plains]].
